## 中文原文

早上你打算煮咖啡，烧水的时候收到同事消息，处理工作消息分心。等你反应过来，水已经完全烧干，水壶还冒出白烟。

## My translation

I was planning to make some coffee, but I received messages from my colleauge when heating up the water. I was distracted for dealing with them. Until I realized, the water has been boiled out, and the water tank spread white smoke.

## Revised version

I’d planned to make some coffee, but I got messages from my colleague while I was boiling the water. I got distracted dealing with them. By the time I noticed, the water had boiled away, and the kettle was giving off white smoke.

## Key phrases

- **boil the water**：烧水
- **by the time I noticed**：直到我反应过来
- **boiled away**：水烧干了
- **kettle**：水壶
- **give off white smoke**：冒出白烟
